comparison.objective: Tune and lock a damper versus reinstall a detached wrist camera.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-key unlocking and fine collar tuning versus grasping, keyed channel insertion, seating, and retaining-tooth engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Dynamic stopping performance and setting retention versus camera alignment within 5 mm/5 degrees, secured release, and live imaging.
comparison.reason: Both include retention, but camera registration and insertion do not test iterative damping adjustment. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift thresholds remain undeclared.
